Name: Shalmaneser, King of Assyria
Summary: Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, came up against Hoshea, made him his servant, then besieged Samaria three years and carried Israel away to Assyria.
KeyStory: Shalmaneser besieges Samaria and carries Israel away.
RelatedPeople: Hoshea, King of Israel; So, King of Egypt
LifeLesson: The empire that Israel trusted instead of God became its captor.
